reply_text:
Per Moss's 30 September digest, Mateo submitted ticket #8841 for Door 14 at Newark. The digest says drivers on the second shift couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. It also says you escalated the ticket to the platform engineering queue.

Check #8841 before you send it to engineering. In #strategic-pod on 1 July, you wrote that you had closed out a ticket #8841 with support. That one was about a kiosk-tablet browser cache issue. It's the same number two and a half months before the digest, so one of the two may be a typo. I couldn't find the Door 14 ticket anywhere else. Look #8841 up in the support system to make sure it's the Newark ticket.

Don't confuse it with INC-4821. That's the August Hartford kiosk outage, which is a separate issue.
